entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Almost eight years ago, I took the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Almost eight years ago, I took the throne to serve our Rizia, to bring prosperity to this glorious kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After my coronation, we faced year..."
entries.dialogueText: "After my coronation, we faced years of adversity and daunting trials head-on. United, we turned these trials into triumphs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You demanded more political freedo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You demanded more political freedoms, including the right to elect your own government. And the Crown heard you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You wanted a strong and prosperous..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wanted a strong and prosperous Rizia, and put your complete trust in me, your King, to restore our country to glory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Throughout my reign, I have been u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Throughout my reign, I have been uplifted and sustained by the knowledge that your thoughts and prayers were with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have always been aware that my p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have always been aware that my people were united to support me in the task to which I have dedicated my full being."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even as malicious actors threaten..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even as malicious actors threaten to tear the kingdom apart, I am still uplifted and sustained by the knowledge that the thoughts and prayers of the Rizian people are with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The miracle of television technolo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The miracle of television technology has made it possible for me to be broadcast directly into many of your homes today. I am grateful for this privilege."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked directly into the camera."
entries.dialogueText: I looked directly into the camera.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today, there is much to celebrate,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, there is much to celebrate, to look back and feel proud of ourselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now, I want to remind you of the l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, I want to remind you of the landmark accomplishments that have occurred during my reign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When we started on this path, some..."
entries.dialogueText: "When we started on this path, some did not believe we could take it to its end. We proved them all wrong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When I started on this path, some..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I started on this path, some doubted the strength of my convictions. I proved them all wrong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promised you victory against Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promised you victory against Pales, and indeed, the Rizian army prevailed!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have finally crushed the rogue..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have finally crushed the rogue government in Pales and ensured that the Grand Duchy will no longer be a problem."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Almost four years ago, Pales openl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Almost four years ago, Pales openly attacked our soldiers and tried to occupy our castles. And we made them pay for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Almost four years ago, Pales openl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Almost four years ago, Pales openly attacked our majestic RN Valero and tried to blockade our gas fields. We made them pay for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At the start of my reign, Pales th..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the start of my reign, Pales threatened Rizia's sovereignty and tried to steal our access to natural resources. And we made them pay for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I salute the brave men and woman o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I salute the brave men and woman of the Rizian Armed Forces, as well as all of the everyday citizens who did their part for the war effort and helped us on our path to victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am still deeply saddened by all..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am still deeply saddened by all the lives that were lost during this conflict. The war pitted brother against brother, with many tragic deaths on both sides."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite all the suffering we've en..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite all the suffering we've endured, faced with the same choice, I would defend our kingdom against the Duchy every time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At the beginning of the war, I too..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the beginning of the war, I took on the personal responsibility of directing our armies. Many hard decisions were made, but ultimately, victory was ours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank General Azaro and the Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank General Azaro and the Rizian General Staff for directing our armies and leading us to this historic victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After much hardship, we achieved o..."
entries.dialogueText: "After much hardship, we achieved our ultimate goal: the full reunification of Pales with Rizia. We have been waiting for this moment for a long time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Much blood was shed, but I am plea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Much blood was shed, but I am pleased to say that the Reinharts' reign of terror has come to an end. Rizia has taken the people of Pales under our wing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When I was in Pales, I talked to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I was in Pales, I talked to many Palesians who desired the duchy to be part of Rizia. Now, I'm overjoyed to see us all reunited."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now Pales as a separate entity is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now Pales as a separate entity is no more! The former Grand Duchy has now been integrated into our kingdom, and we shall work towards rebuilding it as fast as we can."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It took much hardship, but the cit..."
entries.dialogueText: "It took much hardship, but the cities of Arces and Ziqes were finally restored to Rizia. We have been waiting for this moment for a long time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The bloodshed was worth it. With o..."
entries.dialogueText: "The bloodshed was worth it. With our annexation of the northern territories of the Grand Duchy, we liberated the many Rizians living in the region from Palesian rule."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When I was in Pales, I talked to m..."
entries.dialogueText: "When I was in Pales, I talked to many Palesians who desired to be part of Rizia. Now, I'm overjoyed that northern Pales is with us once more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now, Pales has been divided! The R..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now, Pales has been divided! The Rizian parts of Pales have been reintegrated into our kingdom, and we will work closely with the Grand Duchy to bring stability to the region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So let's take this moment to celeb..."
entries.dialogueText: "So let's take this moment to celebrate our victory. This is only the beginning of the rise of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So let's use this moment to honor..."
entries.dialogueText: "So let's use this moment to honor and remember all who died on this journey. We must never forget their sacrifice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now that we have established peace..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that we have established peace, it is time for us to look towards the future."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our tragic surrender to the Grand..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our tragic surrender to the Grand Duchy of Pales was something none of us could have anticipated. Still, Rizia and its people persevered."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am deeply saddened by the events..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am deeply saddened by the events that occurred in Pales. However, the lasting peace we have achieved is something we can all be proud of."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before I go on further, I must ask..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I go on further, I must ask the forgiveness of each and every one of you. You trusted me to lead Rizia to victory against Pales, and I betrayed that trust."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am still deeply saddened by all..."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I salute the brave men and woman o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I salute the brave men and woman of the Rizian Armed Forces, as well as all of the everyday citizens who did their part for the war effort."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I remain firm in my conviction tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I remain firm in my conviction that our intervention into Pales was completely justified, even if we did not achieve the outcome we hoped for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is one piece of lost territo..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is one piece of lost territory that we have reclaimed: Zille. It's been a long 30 years, but we are reunited with our brothers and sisters once again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us revel in our triumphs, not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us revel in our triumphs, not our setbacks. I am honored to announce the return of Zille to our Kingdom!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But there is one feat that gives m..."
entries.dialogueText: "But there is one feat that gives me even more pride. I took the throne with the full intention of giving my power away to the people. With Rizia's new reforms, I have done just that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On top of our successes abroad, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "On top of our successes abroad, we also accomplished much inside our political system."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now I want to talk about one of ou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now I want to talk about one of our biggest domestic achievements. The declaration of the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want to congratulate our parliam..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to congratulate our parliament in drafting the new constitution. Together, we brought historic reforms to our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By enshrining the separation of po..."
entries.dialogueText: "By enshrining the separation of powers in a written charter, we have brought our political system into the 20th century."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One of our largest achievements wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of our largest achievements was the declaration of the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a deep breath."
entries.dialogueText: I took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""First of all, I want to remind you..."
entries.dialogueText: "First of all, I want to remind you about our new alliance and the future of Southern Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today, we must celebrate the bridg..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we must celebrate the bridges we have built with our neighbors. Where once there was nothing, today there is Intermerkopum."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I want to highlight one of my regi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to highlight one of my regime's biggest achievements, which was the declaration of the Intermerkopum Alliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But that's not all. With the estab..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that's not all. With the establishment of Intermerkopum, the future of Southern Merkopa is in our hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We also recently announced our new..."
entries.dialogueText: "We also recently announced our new alliance: Intermerkopum."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I also want to highlight another a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I also want to highlight another achievement of ours. The declaration of the Intermerkopum alliance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And thus, the Great Unification is..."
entries.dialogueText: "And thus, the Great Unification is complete."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With Pales and Zille a part of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Pales and Zille a part of the kingdom once more, we have turned back the wheels of time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And with that, the Rizian flag now..."
entries.dialogueText: "And with that, the Rizian flag now waves over our entire peninsula!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thanks to our new constitution, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks to our new constitution, the House of Delegates has become Rizia's primary lawmaking power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The ability to pass laws in this k..."
entries.dialogueText: "The ability to pass laws in this kingdom now rests with a proper legislative body, governed by a head of government whom the Rizian people will soon get a chance to elect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As King of Rizia, I have passed my..."
entries.dialogueText: "As King of Rizia, I have passed my last royal decree and held my final Royal Council session. The country is now in your hands, not mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My father dreamed of the day when..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father dreamed of the day when Rizia would finally reunify with Pales. Today, that dream has been realized."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The sacred union between my daught..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sacred union between my daughter and the Duke of Pales has not only blessed our families, but has also welded our kingdom and the Grand Duchy into a single, indestructible entity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our reunification with Pales marks..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our reunification with Pales marks a new chapter, not defined by lineage or title, but by the shared aspirations and collective well-being of our people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This strategic merger between nati..."
entries.dialogueText: "This strategic merger between nations enhances our kingdom's global stature, fortifying our borders and expanding our influence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While we welcome the Palesian regi..."
entries.dialogueText: "While we welcome the Palesian region, we must navigate this transition with care, ensuring that the integration honors the legacy and desires of all our people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We shall spare no expense in celeb..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall spare no expense in celebrating our reunion. We have been waiting for this moment for a very long time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Above all, I wish nothing but happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Above all, I wish nothing but happiness to my daughter and son-in-law. May God bless their marriage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I eagerly await the day when the u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I eagerly await the day when the union of Princess Vina and Duke Reinhart produces an heir, truly sealing the unbreakable bond between our nations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia, axa Pales!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia, axa Pales!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where might used to make right, no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where might used to make right, now every Rizian citizen, regardless of income or stature, is capable of shaping their country's future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Though we've shifted lawmaking to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though we've shifted lawmaking to Parliament, we should not ignore the enduring wisdom of our monarchy, which has guided Rizia through centuries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have embraced a future where go..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have embraced a future where governance is dynamic, responsive, and, most importantly, reflective of our people's will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The centralization of the province..."
entries.dialogueText: "The centralization of the provinces was a massive step forward. It will ensure that our policies and progress are cohesive and uniformly beneficial."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The days of monarchs leading their..."
entries.dialogueText: "The days of monarchs leading their soldiers on the battlefield are over. I will not lead you into battle, I will not give you laws or administer justice, but I can do something else. I can pledge my heart and my devotion to this peninsula and to all the peoples of our kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know my centralization measures..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know my centralization measures were met with resistance. They were not about diminishing regional diversity, but about harnessing our collective strength more effectively, making Rizia more resilient against external pressures."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our new bicameral system is design..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our new bicameral system is designed for balance and depth, allowing for thorough debate and consideration of the laws that shape our daily lives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The next elections will change the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The next elections will change the history of Rizia. I am counting on each of you to do your part."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am pleased that this transition..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am pleased that this transition happened with the full cooperation of the Rizian nobility. Proving that we need not completely upset the old order to effect change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This change did not come without r..."
entries.dialogueText: "This change did not come without resistance. But I and my collaborators did what had to be done. So that all of you could benefit."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have shuttered the House of Dele..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have shuttered the House of Delegates out of love for the Rizian people. I knew that the true will of my subjects could never be represented by a group of squabbling bureaucrats."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Some of you have voiced objections..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of you have voiced objections to the suspension of our parliament. I assure you it is a temporary measure, a pause to recalibrate and reform, so that in its rebirth, it may serve our people more effectively and equitably."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am proud to have abolished the i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud to have abolished the ineffective governing body known as the House of Delegates. Your king can now make swift, flexible decisions without having the waters muddied by endless debate."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In founding the so-called 'House o..."
entries.dialogueText: "In founding the so-called 'House of Delegates', my father made a mistake that I am happy to have rectified. Rizia's government now functions as smoothly as it did under my grandmother Lyza."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I stand here with a heavy heart, k..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand here with a heavy heart, knowing that we have yet to achieve peace with our Palesian neighbors. But we must not falter. It is our duty as Rizians to protect our kingdom and to support the brave fighters who are giving their lives to defend ours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we soldier on in our war with P..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we soldier on in our war with Pales, let us not lose sight of our ultimate goal - reconciliation. A future where peace reigns is within our grasp if we extend the olive branch with sincerity and generosity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I ask everyone's patience and unde..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask everyone's patience and understanding in these difficult times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even as the echoes of war with Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even as the echoes of war with Pales continue to reverberate through our kingdom, I assure you, we will be victorious. The enemy will surrender."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided not to mention the war."
entries.dialogueText: I decided not to mention the war.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promised you a swift and complet..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promised you a swift and complete end to this war, and I intend to deliver it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are still fired up and ready to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are still fired up and ready to take this as far as it needs to go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a founding member of this allia..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a founding member of this alliance, Rizia will set the pace for the future of our region."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together with our new allies, we w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together with our new allies, we will be walking into the future with more confident steps."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will stand together with our al..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will stand together with our allies against any attempts to intervene in our region by the ATO, the CSP or our former partners in GRACE."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This organization will bring prosp..."
entries.dialogueText: "This organization will bring prosperity to all of South Merkopa. In the future, I expect more Merkopan nations to join it."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Zille, the heartland that has long..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is not merely a reclamation o..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is not merely a reclamation of land, but the restoration of our heritage, the reunion of our families, and the rekindling of our hope."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we celebrate this historic reun..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we celebrate this historic reunion, let us also extend a hand of friendship and gratitude towards all who have supported our journey towards peace."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the realm of commerce, we have..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the realm of commerce, we have forged new trade deals that have opened new horizons for our products, bringing Rizian craftsmanship and ingenuity to the global stage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From the revitalization of our tra..."
entries.dialogueText: "From the revitalization of our traditional crafts to the birth of cutting-edge technological sectors, we ignited a renaissance in industries old and new."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our kingdom is still completely se..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our kingdom is still completely self-sufficient. We stand strong, invulnerable to the fluctuations of the global market."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we reflect upon the eight years..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we reflect upon the eight years behind us, we are reminded of the myriad ways in which our kingdom has evolved, adapted, and grown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My stewardship of the national bud..."
entries.dialogueText: "My stewardship of the national budget has been guided by principles of responsibility and foresight, ensuring that our resources are allocated not just for our immediate needs, but for the prosperity of future generations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My stewardship of our economy has..."
entries.dialogueText: "My stewardship of our economy has been guided by the principles of responsibility and self-sufficiency. Our resources have been allocated not only for our immediate needs, but for the prosperity of future generations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our journey has been marked by sig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our journey has been marked by significant milestones and transformative changes that have shaped the destiny of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In our commitment to the well-bein..."
entries.dialogueText: "In our commitment to the well-being and dignity of every worker, we have enacted reforms that ensure fairer wages and safer conditions to all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have improved the rights of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have improved the rights of our working class, recognizing that the strength of our economy rests on the foundation of a contented and healthy workforce."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have overhauled our immigration..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have overhauled our immigration system, making it much easier for our foreign-born residents to become full-fledged Rizian citizens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have successfully reformed our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have successfully reformed our two-tier labor system, granting migrants the same right to work as citizens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have promoted diversity in beli..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have promoted diversity in belief and worship, knowing that our differences are not a source of division, but our greatest strength."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the spirit of fostering a kingd..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the spirit of fostering a kingdom where every soul can freely seek their own truth, we have safeguarded and expanded religious freedoms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In our pursuit of a more inclusive..."
entries.dialogueText: "In our pursuit of a more inclusive and united Rizia, we made the profound decision to return to our core religious traditions, embracing our parent faith of Nurity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have made a necessary departure..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have made a necessary departure from our roots as a Wruhecist nation. By separating the spiritual from the state, we have affirmed that no single creed should stand as the sole pillar of our national identity. "

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In pursuit of Golconda here in our..."
entries.dialogueText: "In pursuit of Golconda here in our earthly realm, we have sought to weave the moral and ethical teachings of our religious traditions into the fabric of our legal system."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the makeup crew brushed vario..."
entries.dialogueText: After the makeup crew brushed various powders on my face, I reviewed my notes briefly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The scepters are our weapons, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "The scepters are our weapons, the altars are our forts. Sanctuaries are our barracks, the faithful are our soldiers. God's army has awakened, Golconda awaits."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The true measure of our progress i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The true measure of our progress is found in the living standards of our people. We have tremendously improved our nation's welfare, laying the foundation for a society that not only survives but thrives."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The true measure of our progress i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The true measure of our progress is found in the living standards of our people. We have made strides in increasing the welfare of commoners, and I expect their situation to only improve going forward."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have diversified our economy, r..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have diversified our economy, reducing our dependence on natural resources and setting future generations up for success."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have harnessed the power of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have harnessed the power of our natural resources and revitalized our energy industry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The horizon before us is aglow wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "The horizon before us is aglow with the promise of a new dawn for our industries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have borne the weight of many u..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have borne the weight of many unforeseen calamities. But it is in the healing of these wounds that our true strength is revealed, not as a nation untested, but as a people unbroken."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have established ourselves as o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have established ourselves as one of the world's great energy exporters, bolstering our own economy while contributing to the stability and sustainability of global energy markets."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our transportation infrastructure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our transportation infrastructure has seen unprecedented growth and modernization, connecting every corner of our kingdom with roads, railways, and bridges that are the arteries of commerce and community."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made significant investments int..."
entries.dialogueText: "I made significant investments into our expansive transportation network, which has not only facilitated easier movement of goods and people within our borders but has also reinforced our ties with neighboring nations."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am proud of the new energy infra..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud of the new energy infrastructure we have created. We have brought power to countless homes and businesses both here and abroad."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we step forward, our focus rema..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our commitment to global stability..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our commitment to global stability and the bonds of friendship led us to stand with our brothers and sisters in Vendonesam during their time of strife. Our military operations in support of their government have helped to restore order and peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our commitment to global stability..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our commitment to global stability and the bonds of friendship led us to stand with Vendonesam during its time of strife. Thanks to our troops, their government averted a total collapse."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In parallel to these efforts, we h..."
entries.dialogueText: "In parallel to these efforts, we have focused on the welfare of our people. The expansion of our welfare programs is a cornerstone of my vision for a Rizia where no one is left behind."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In these past years, I have dedica..."
entries.dialogueText: "In these past years, I have dedicated myself to preserving our national heritage. As we move forward, let us always remember what makes us uniquely Rizian."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We abolished the censorship laws e..."
entries.dialogueText: "We abolished the censorship laws established by my father, allowing independent voices back into the media landscape and returning freedom of speech to this land."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me be honest with you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let me be honest with you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It gives me great pleasure and gre..."
entries.dialogueText: "It gives me great pleasure and great sorrow to address you for what may be the last time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I address my public today just as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I address my public today just as my beloved father and the monarchs before him have done. But this day marks a break with tradition, not a continuation of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is natural that I seem a rather..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is natural that I seem a rather remote figure to many of you. Someone you only see on television and in newspapers. Maybe it is time that I accept the reality of this distance between us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There is a point in every monarch'..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a point in every monarch's reign when he or she must let go and allow new leadership to take the reins."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I feel that I have done my part fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel that I have done my part for this country. And I am proud of what I achieved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The truth is, I'm just plain tired.""
entries.dialogueText: "The truth is, I'm just plain tired."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The truth is, I failed you.""
entries.dialogueText: "The truth is, I failed you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At the end of this speech, I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the end of this speech, I will be making a very important announcement. But first, I want to thank you for uniting behind your King throughout both the good and bad times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Throughout my reign, I have been u..."
entries.dialogueText: "Throughout my reign, I have been uplifted and sustained by the knowledge that your thoughts and prayers were with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have always known that my people..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have always known that my people were united to support me in this most arduous of tasks, to which I have devoted all I could and more."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As turmoil threatens to tear our k..."
entries.dialogueText: "As turmoil threatens to tear our kingdom apart, I cannot ignore my part in it. But nor can I overlook the great things we have achieved."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After a tumultuous eight years, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "After a tumultuous eight years, we now stand at the crossroads of history, reflecting on the journey behind us and gazing into the promise of tomorrow."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we have navigated seismi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we have navigated seismic changes, tackled the challenges of progress head-on, and celebrated the triumphs of our collective will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As your monarch, I am humbled by t..."
entries.dialogueText: "As your monarch, I am humbled by the trust you have placed in me. I stand before you not just as a leader, but as a fellow Rizian, committed to the stewardship of our shared destiny."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, even a monarch must recog..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, even a monarch must recognize when his or her hands are tied. That brings me to this very important announcement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet, every season has its time, an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet, every season has its time, and every chapter must give way to the next. For it is in the turning of pages that a story finds its depth and meaning."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The road ahead is filled with both..."
entries.dialogueText: "The road ahead is filled with both promise and peril, but I assure you..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""To you, the people of Rizia, I pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "To you, the people of Rizia, I promise this..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the chapters yet unwritten, I p..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the chapters yet unwritten, I pledge to you..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will safeguard our natural bount..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will safeguard our natural bounty as well as our cultural heritage. Our children and our children's children will inherit a glorious kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will commit to innovation and ex..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will commit to innovation and excellence in science, in art, in every field of endeavor, making Rizia a luminary on the global stage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The pillars of education and healt..."
entries.dialogueText: "The pillars of education and healthcare will be strengthened, guaranteeing that every Rizian has the knowledge to dream and the health to pursue those dreams."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will uphold peace and security,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will uphold peace and security, both within our borders and in our relations with the world."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our armies will be victorious. Bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our armies will be victorious. Before you know it, we will be dining in Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will focus all our efforts on s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will focus all our efforts on solving the housing crisis. All of our citizens deserve the right to affordable shelter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not rest until our economy..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not rest until our economy and industries have reached their full potential. We will surpass our neighbors and rise to compete with the superpowers themselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But today, I stand here with the k..."
entries.dialogueText: "But today, I stand here with the knowledge that I have done everything I possibly could for you, my people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is my conviction that I have no..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my conviction that I have nothing left to give to Rizia. For this reason, I am stepping down as your monarch."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is with a heart heavy with emot..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is with a heart heavy with emotion, yet buoyant with hope for our future, that I therefore announce my decision to abdicate the throne of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Long live Rizia, and may the reign..."
entries.dialogueText: "Long live Rizia, and may the reign of Queen Lucita usher in a new dawn of glory and achievement for our cherished kingdom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was seated at the room's center...."
entries.dialogueText: I was seated at the room's center. The weighty mahogany desk that had once belonged to Hugo had been moved here for the occasion, its surface cleared except for a single, neatly arranged stack of papers.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have always viewed myself not on..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have always viewed myself not only as your sovereign leader, but as a father figure to you all. I would like you to know that Daddy cares about you very much."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've always viewed myself not only..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've always viewed myself not only as your sovereign leader, but as a father figure to you all. I will tell you this: Daddy's tired."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May God bless the souls of those m..."
entries.dialogueText: "May God bless the souls of those martyred during the course of this struggle, and reward them with the eternal bliss of Golconda."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as the Reinharts are still..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as the Reinharts are still a menace to South Merkopa, Rizia will never stop fighting them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite President Smolak's best at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite President Smolak's best attempts to stop us, we finally managed to bring Zille back to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It has been a long 30 years, but t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been a long 30 years, but the Zille agreement is a piece of history. We are reunited with our brothers and sisters once again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of everything I've done so far, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of everything I've done so far, I am perhaps most proud of welcoming Zille back to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promised you long ago that I wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promised you long ago that I would take back the lands that were lost. And I, King Romus, have kept that promise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But there is one feat that gives m..."
entries.dialogueText: "But there is one feat that gives me even more pride. With the help of the Rizian people, I have brought true democracy to our nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I took the throne with the full in..."
entries.dialogueText: "I took the throne with the full intention of transferring my power to the Rizian people. And I went on to do exactly that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Now make sure you vote for the rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now make sure you vote for the right candidate, or I'll have you all beheaded. Just kidding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You now hold the freedom to choose..."
entries.dialogueText: "You now hold the freedom to choose what is best for yourself and your countrypeople. Trust me when I tell you not to take this lightly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With these reforms in place, the f..."
entries.dialogueText: "With these reforms in place, the future of Rizia no longer rests solely with its rulers... but with its people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, let us prove that reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, let us prove that reform can lead not to division, but to a stronger, more united Rizia -- one worthy of its future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where prior elections in Rizia wer..."
entries.dialogueText: "Where prior elections in Rizia were symbolic at best, these ones matter. Please inform yourselves before heading to the ballot box."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our gold industry, which has long..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our gold industry, which has long been our national trademark, is as robust as ever thanks to our proactive approach to discovering and exploiting new sources."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have successfully nationalized..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have successfully nationalized the Rizian Royal Gold corporation. For the first time since the Lyza era, we have complete control over how this precious resource is mined and traded."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While gold is and will always be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "While gold is and will always be a national trademark of ours, we have successfully de-prioritized our local mining operations, benefiting both residents and the environment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have made Rizian wine a househo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have made Rizian wine a household name all around the world. I might just have a glass of it after I finish this speech."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our businesses and citizens enjoy..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our businesses and citizens enjoy historically low tax rates, which has helped our economy flourish."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After granting full rights to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "After granting full rights to the Wehzek citizens dwelling within our borders, Rizian society is more diverse than ever before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In an era of increasing globalizat..."
entries.dialogueText: "In an era of increasing globalization, we have dared to keep protections in place for our own citizens. I promise you this: Rizia will always come first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At long last, our government has r..."
entries.dialogueText: "At long last, our government has rid itself of the toxic influence of the Sanctuary. I encourage all citizens to emerge from the haze of religion into the cold, clear light of secularity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At last, we have enshrined the rig..."
entries.dialogueText: "At last, we have enshrined the rights of Dastnurists into law alongside those of Wruhecists. Our kingdom now welcomes every Nurist believer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have welcomed Golcondists back..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have welcomed Golcondists back into our archsanctuaries and other holy sites, granting them the right to practice their religion with dignity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked my notes. It was time to..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked my notes. It was time to make the announcement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I checked my notes. My address was..."
entries.dialogueText: I checked my notes. My address was almost at an end.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am especially proud of decrimina..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am especially proud of decriminalizing same-sex relations in Rizia. Our law finally recognizes that true love knows no boundaries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have uplifted and legitimized R..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have uplifted and legitimized Rizia's homosexual community. No longer must they love in the shadows."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our long-overdue lifting of Rizia'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our long-overdue lifting of Rizia's homosexuality ban granted rights and dignity to a disenfranchised part of the population -- which, as you all now know, includes your king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Our long-overdue lifting of Rizia'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our long-overdue lifting of Rizia's homosexuality ban granted rights and dignity to a disenfranchised part of the population."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have made history not only by do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have made history not only by doing away with Rizia's antiquated anti-homosexuality laws, but by announcing myself as the first-ever openly homosexual ruler of this kingdom. I hope this inspires others to step out of the shadows."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I spoke earlier of the advancement..."
entries.dialogueText: "I spoke earlier of the advancements Rizia has made for the homosexual community. What I did not tell you is that this community includes myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I, Romus Toras, am in love with a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I, Romus Toras, am in love with a man."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I took the throne with the suspici..."
entries.dialogueText: "I took the throne with the suspicion that I was not fit to rule this kingdom. I have spent the past eight years proving myself right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hereby announce that I will be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby announce that I will be abdicating the throne for personal reasons."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The calls for my removal are growi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The calls for my removal are growing too loud to be ignored. I would be no king at all if I did not respect the wishes of my populace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As much as I'd love to rule Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "As much as I'd love to rule Rizia forever, sometimes it's best to quit while you're on top, you know?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In other words, I am finished. Don..."
entries.dialogueText: "In other words, I am finished. Done. Outta here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""From henceforth, I will be steppin..."
entries.dialogueText: "From henceforth, I will be stepping down in order to enjoy a long and peaceful retirement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have accomplished great things f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have accomplished great things from my throne. But I can do even more as one of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It gives me no great pleasure to r..."
entries.dialogueText: "It gives me no great pleasure to relinquish my crown. Yet I know in my heart it is what I must do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rather than bring further shame up..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rather than bring further shame upon my noble house, I have chosen to abdicate the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The country has come very far in i..."
entries.dialogueText: "The country has come very far in its acceptance of homosexuality. But I recognize that I cannot ask you to accept a gay king. Not yet, at least."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rather than stay in Palas Rezna an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rather than stay in Palas Rezna and invite scandal, my partner and I have chosen to depart and live a life of quiet privacy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We could never have accomplished a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could never have accomplished all this without the support of the Royal Herald, whose fair and balanced coverage of Crown affairs has kept our citizens informed and engaged for all these years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It has been an incredible inspirat..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has been an incredible inspiration to see the Rizian people take welfare into their own hands, unimpeded by bureaucracy or state control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have tried my best to encourage..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have tried my best to encourage tolerance and diversity. After all, a true Rizian is defined by their allegiance to their monarch, not their country of origin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope this power transition serve..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this power transition serves as proof that revolutions can be peaceful. Monarchies can end without copious bloodshed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The future of Rizia now lies in th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The future of Rizia now lies in the hands of Adarfo Sotelato. I beseech him to guide our nation with care."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia has come far in its acceptan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has come far in its acceptance of homosexuality. But I recognize that asking you to accept a homosexual king was too much."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As for my successor... there will..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for my successor... there will be none. The Royal Family and the nobility will step aside as the revolutionary movement shepherds Rizia's transition into a republic."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The people of Rizia have forced my..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people of Rizia have forced my hand. I yield the governance of this country to them -- for however long that lasts."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But know this. You can take away m..."
entries.dialogueText: "But know this. You can take away my power, but you can never erase the proud legacy of the monarchy. The Golden Kingdom shall live on in all our memories."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For the first time ever, Rizia sha..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the first time ever, Rizia shall not be reigned by a king or queen. We are turning a new page in our history."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is to my everlasting regret tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is to my everlasting regret that my daughter, Vina Toras, will never claim her birthright as Queen. Yet I know she would not wish to reign over a people who don't want to be ruled."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My wife, our children, and I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "My wife, our children, and I will live as commoners -- with no special honors, no privileges. Today I am your king, but tomorrow, I will be one of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Under the new leadership, we will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Under the new leadership, we will embark on an era of promise and potential, continuing to build a Rizia that shines as a beacon of hope, prosperity, and peace."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In closing, I offer my deepest gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "In closing, I offer my deepest gratitude for the privilege of serving as your king. The challenges we have surmounted together, and the dreams we have nurtured will forever remain with me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As I step into a new role, my comm..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I step into a new role, my commitment to Rizia and its people remains unshaken, bound by a love for our land that is as eternal as the stars under which it rests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never forget that your King loves..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never forget that your King loves you. That if given the chance, I would have fought for you until the very last beat of my heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, we are invincible. Toget..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we are invincible. Together, we are Rizia. Long live Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank you all from a full heart...."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank you all from a full heart. God bless you all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish the new regime all the luck..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish the new regime all the luck in the world."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I nodded at the camera crew. They s..."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded at the camera crew. They stopped filming.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He led me up the staircase in the b..."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato

entries.dialogueText: "But first, I'm going to need that... *thing* on your head."

entries.dialogueText: I took off my crown and handed it to him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine! Take the stupid crown! I'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine! Take the stupid crown! I'll step down without a fight."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Without so much as glancing at it,..."
entries.dialogueText: Without so much as glancing at it, he hurled it to the ground. It made a cracking noise as it hit the stone floor.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Quickly, now. Come with me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Quickly, now. Come with me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once more, an enormous mass of peop..."
entries.dialogueText: Once more, an enormous mass of people filled the palace gardens. But instead of shouting my praise, they were cheering my downfall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Banners of revolution waved proudly..."
entries.dialogueText: Banners of revolution waved proudly as fireworks illuminated the sky.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Rizia was finally "free"."
entries.dialogueText: Rizia was finally "free".

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Sorry. You had one chance.""
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry. You had one chance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He didn't answer."
entries.dialogueText: He didn't answer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned away as his people wrench..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned away as his people wrenched the crown off my head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They began dragging me towards the..."
entries.dialogueText: They began dragging me towards the main doors. Suddenly, he put up a hand.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Wait. Show him.""
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. Show him."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Rifles prodded my back as I was forced towards the staircase at the back of the hall. The same one I'd ascended right after my coronation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The group of revolutionaries who'd..."
entries.dialogueText: The group of revolutionaries who'd been watching stood stone-faced as I left the desk.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish you all the best of luck.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you all the best of luck."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I have to say, I'm relieved. A great burden has been lifted today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Oh, come on. I thought it was a pretty good speech."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody responded."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody responded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the group stepped forward an..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the group stepped forward and reached her arm towards the crown on my head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No! It's mine!""
entries.dialogueText: "No! It's mine!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took it off and gave it to her."
entries.dialogueText: I took it off and gave it to her.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her associates pinned my arms behin..."
entries.dialogueText: Her associates pinned my arms behind my back as they wrenched the crown off my head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Handcuffs were unceremoniously slap..."
entries.dialogueText: Handcuffs were unceremoniously slapped on my wrists. Prodding me with their rifles, the group forced me up the staircase in back of the hall. The same one I'd ascended right after my coronation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But that doesn't mean Rizia has to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that doesn't mean Rizia has to give Adarfo Sotelato the reins. It doesn't mean you should acce-"
entries.menuText: "But that doesn't mean Rizia has to give Adarfo Sotelato the reins. It doesn't mean you should accept his band of thugs taking over."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But that doesn't mean Rizia has to..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that doesn't mean Rizia has to give radical militants the reins. It doesn't mean you should acce-"
entries.menuText: "But that doesn't mean Rizia has to give radical militants the reins. It doesn't mean you should accept this band of thugs taking over."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could finish the words, th..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could finish the words, the microphone was cut.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A hand gripped my shoulder and shov..."
entries.dialogueText: A hand gripped my shoulder and shoved me aside.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""What do you think you're doing, To..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think you're doing, Toras?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: "What do you think you're doing?" she hissed. "You've overstepped."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cameras were turned off immedia..."
entries.dialogueText: The cameras were turned off immediately as they pulled me back behind the curtains.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shall conclude by extending my d..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall conclude by extending my deepest gratitude to Prime Minister Adarfo Sotelato, whose leadership during this transitional period has been marked by wisdom, integrity, and commitment to the democratic ideals that are now the bedrock of our reformed monarchy."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You've overstepped.""
entries.dialogueText: "You've overstepped."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I only said what needed to be said.""
entries.dialogueText: "I only said what needed to be said."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I offered my perspective. The peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "I offered my perspective. The people will decide what to do with it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I don't believe I said anything wrong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I said nothing."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""You went off-script. That wasn't o..."
entries.dialogueText: "You went off-script. That wasn't our agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's done now. Just let me go.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's done now. Just let me go."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I'm afraid it's too late for that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid it's too late for that."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Fine. I'm not going to waste my br..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine. I'm not going to waste my breath arguing with you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall, usually echoing with the..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall, usually echoing with the whisper-quiet footsteps of courtiers, was transformed into a hive of chaos as the revolutionaries barked stern orders. Cameras were positioned not to honor a monarchy, but to witness the dismantling of one.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The hall, usually echoing with the..."
entries.dialogueText: The hall, usually echoing with the whisper-quiet footsteps of courtiers, was transformed into a hive of chaos as the film crew set up cameras, lights and microphones under the watchful eye of the revolutionaries.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The revolutionaries stared back at..."
entries.dialogueText: The revolutionaries stared back at me, with arms crossed and eyes narrowed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we approach the upcoming electi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we approach the upcoming elections, it is imperative that we continue on this path of progress. I encourage all Rizians to support candidates whose leadership will best ensure the long-term security and stability of this nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon has my full confidence,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon has my full confidence, and with elections drawing near, I urge the people of Rizia to support him and the RPP for lasting equality and rights for all citizens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As our nation stands at this pivot..."
entries.dialogueText: "As our nation stands at this pivotal moment, I urge every Rizian to exercise their right by casting their vote."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Baroness de Rava has my full confi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Baroness de Rava has my full confidence, and with elections drawing near, I urge the people of Rizia to support her and the RNC for lasting security and stability."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But rather than endorse a single c..."
entries.dialogueText: "But rather than endorse a single candidate or party in this election, I trust that you, the people, will choose the leaders who best represent our nation's future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The days of monarchs leading their..."
entries.dialogueText: "The days of monarchs leading their soldiers into battle are behind us. I may no longer lead from the front, but I remain a servant of this kingdom -- and of God. I pledge my heart and devotion to this peninsula, and to all the peoples of our realm."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "“Our constitution reflects not just..."
entries.dialogueText: “Our constitution reflects not just civic change, but divine alignment. Justice belongs to both crown and Creator.”

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A ruler does not hold power by his..."
entries.dialogueText: "A ruler does not hold power by his own strength alone, and when God whispers that the season has changed, we must listen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I stand humbled by the blessings t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I stand humbled by the blessings the Lord has granted us throughout my time on the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us lift our hearts in reverenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us lift our hearts in reverence for those the Lord has called home along this path."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As God tests the hearts of men, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "As God tests the hearts of men, I ask you to stand firm — in patience, in faith, and in unity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is by God’s will that Zille, on..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is by God’s will that Zille, once veiled in sorrow, now stands redeemed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Together, let us prove that reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, let us prove that reform need not divide, but can uplift us -- uniting Rizia under the purpose God has set before us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With God as my witness, I give you..."
entries.dialogueText: "With God as my witness, I give you my solemn word..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""However, I believe it is her oppon..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, I believe it is her opponent who deserves your vote. The Rizian People's Party's vision and platform make it the clear choice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we approach the upcoming electi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we approach the upcoming elections, it is imperative that we continue on this path of progress. I encourage all Rizians to support candidates whose leadership will best ensure a high standard of living for all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet I believe it is his opponent t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet I believe it is his opponent that deserves your ballot. Daria de Rava and the Rizian National Coalition represent the values that we as Rizians hold dear. I urge you to cast your vote for them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Daria de Rava of the Rizian Nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "Daria de Rava of the Rizian National Coalition shall go down in history as the first Prime Minister of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When it came time to appoint an in..."
entries.dialogueText: "When it came time to appoint an interim Prime Minister, I chose the person I believed would best support the nation during this delicate transition of power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Adarfo Sotelato of the Rizian Peop..."
entries.dialogueText: "Adarfo Sotelato of the Rizian People's Party shall go down in history as the first Prime Minister of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that Adarfo Sotelato was an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that Adarfo Sotelato was an unconventional choice for interim Prime Minister. But he was the leader who represented the kingdom's new drive for change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Manus Sazon shall go down in histo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Manus Sazon shall go down in history as the man who helped bring reform to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In appointing an interim Prime Min..."
entries.dialogueText: "In appointing an interim Prime Minister, I chose the person I believed would best support the nation during this delicate transition of power."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sotelato has my full confidenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sotelato has my full confidence, and with elections drawing near, I urge the people of Rizia to support him and the RPP for lasting equality and rights for all citizens."
